    Enough injectives in C(D) (Proposition 4.4) #

    An object U of C(D) whose image ρU is injective in Rep k I satisfies E(-, U) = Ext¹(ρ-, ρU) = 0, hence is injective. For an object A, the good representation ρA embeds into a good injective J; the cokernel is good, hence ρ of some object C, and the resulting short exact sequence ρA → J → ρC is realized by a conflation A → B → C with ρB ≅ J injective.
